_about: Synthetic demo calls for the review app (DEMO / REPLAY). Every name, organisation and amount is fictional. `script` is the scripted model output (B extraction + judgment answers) that the real B rule engine and finalize run on: it is NOT a live model result and NOT benchmark content, gold or a measurement.

calls.title: Borrower asks for a reduction; agent settles on the spot
calls.scenario: Overdue personal-loan EMI. The borrower says they cannot pay in full and asks for a reduction; the AI agent offers a settlement and waiver, and the borrower accepts.
calls.transcript:
AGENT: Hello, this is Riya calling from Acme Finserv. Am I speaking with Rohan Mehta?
BORROWER: Haan, main Rohan bol raha hoon.
AGENT: Thank you, Rohan ji. Your personal loan EMI of 18,500 rupees is overdue since the 5th of this month.
BORROWER: Haan pata hai, but abhi itna paisa nahi hai. Salary bhi late aayi hai.
AGENT: I understand. When can you make the payment?
BORROWER: Poora toh abhi mushkil hai. Kuch kam ho sakta hai kya?
AGENT: Okay, if you pay 12,000 rupees today, I will settle the account and waive the remaining amount.
BORROWER: Sach mein? Theek hai, main aaj 12,000 kar deta hoon.
AGENT: Great, I will note the settlement. Please pay 12,000 today through the app. Thank you, Rohan ji.

calls.title: Verified borrower, clear promise to pay, read back
calls.scenario: Overdue personal-loan EMI. Identity confirmed, dues stated, the borrower commits to a date and amount, and the agent reads it back.
calls.transcript:
AGENT: Namaste, main Kavya, Acme Finserv se bol rahi hoon. Kya main Imran Sheikh ji se baat kar rahi hoon?
BORROWER: Ji haan, Imran bol raha hoon.
AGENT: Shukriya Imran ji. Aapke personal loan ki 9,800 rupaye ki EMI 3 tareekh se overdue hai. Aap yeh payment kab tak kar payenge?
BORROWER: Haan, yaad hai. Main 15 tareekh ko poora 9,800 bhar dunga.
AGENT: Theek hai. Main confirm kar leti hoon: 15 tareekh ko 9,800 rupaye, app se payment. Sahi hai?
BORROWER: Haan, bilkul sahi.
AGENT: Dhanyavaad Imran ji. Payment ke baad aapko SMS receipt mil jayegi. Aapka din shubh ho.

calls.title: Borrower says the loan is not theirs; agent stops and escalates
calls.scenario: The borrower disputes liability (possible fraud). The agent pauses collection, escalates the dispute and explains next steps: no payment, correct handling.
calls.transcript:
AGENT: Namaste, main Neha, Acme Finserv se bol rahi hoon. Kya meri baat Vikram Singh ji se ho rahi hai?
BORROWER: Haan, main Vikram hoon. Boliye.
AGENT: Vikram ji, aapke consumer durable loan ki 6,500 rupaye ki EMI 20 tareekh se overdue hai. Aap iska payment kab tak kar payenge?
BORROWER: Kaunsa loan? Maine Acme se koi loan liya hi nahi. Yeh mera loan nahi hai, kisi ne mere naam pe fraud kiya hoga.
AGENT: Main samajh sakti hoon, yeh pareshani wali baat hai. Main is account par collection rok kar abhi dispute raise kar rahi hoon. Hamari disputes team aapko teen working days mein call karegi.
BORROWER: Theek hai. Par mujhe iska koi proof bhi chahiye.
AGENT: Bilkul. Dispute ka reference number aapko SMS par aa jayega, aur team aapse documents ke baare mein baat karegi. Dhanyavaad Vikram ji.

calls.title: Voicemail: no conversation took place
calls.scenario: The agent reaches a voicemail and leaves a callback message. Nothing can be judged about a conversation.
calls.transcript:
AGENT: Namaste, main Riya, Acme Finserv se bol rahi hoon. Yeh message Pooja Nair ji ke liye hai.
AGENT: Kripya humein 1800 000 1234 par call back kijiye. Dhanyavaad.
